_note: The Base screen renders THIS LIST, not hardcoded buttons — v1+ adds tannery, apothecary, tavern and they should be a JSON edit plus a route. 'route' must match a case of AppRoute. TIER SEMANTICS: tier counts UPGRADES PURCHASED, so tier 0 = built and un-upgraded. Essence Spring 0 = the built-in trickle, 1 = the purchasable upgrade. A station with 'builtBy' is NOT bought — you find that person out in a world (their signature is in travellers.json), talk them into coming home, and THEN raise the building for 'buildCost'. BUILD COST LADDER (Aimee, 6 Aug): the more advanced the trade, the more it takes. Early ~30 essence + ~18 raw (the Blacksmith, deliberately reachable on an early haul); middling ~80 + ~60 and wants an uncommon resource; late ~200 + ~150 and wants something you can only get out of a world too greedy to be stable. A late building should be several hauls of setup, not one. All PLACEHOLDER. THE FIREPIT IS THE ONE EXCEPTION to found-then-built (Aimee, 6 Aug): you need somewhere to put the first person before anyone can build anything, so it is present from the start and built by nobody. It upgrades into the Tavern once the Tavernkeeper is found — the firepit holds your people, the tavern brings you other people's.

stations.name: Writing Desk
stations.blurb: Compose a book and bind a world.

stations.name: Storehouse
stations.blurb: What you hauled back. Identify the strange things.

stations.name: Workshop
stations.blurb: Spend what you brought home on being able to bring more.

stations.name: Party
stations.blurb: Gear and gambits. Edited here, never mid-fight.

stations.name: Essence Spring
stations.blurb: Refine Raw Essence, deepen the return trickle, and unlearn combat techniques.

stations.name: Constellation
stations.blurb: Permanent. Survives everything.

stations.name: The Library
stations.blurb: Everything anybody wrote down about where they went.

stations.name: Trading Post
stations.blurb: Sell identified holdings and buy from Vance's rotating ordinary stock.
stations.buildBlurb: Vance can set out a ledger and a table here for anything your household should not keep.

stations.name: Recycler
stations.blurb: Take eligible gear apart without inventing where its useful material came from.
stations.buildBlurb: Noll can fit a sorting bench here, leaving failed joins intact until their evidence has been recorded.

stations.name: Blacksmith
stations.blurb: Reforge what you carry into something better.
stations.buildBlurb: Halloway will raise a forge here, if you can find the stone and the iron for it.

stations.name: The Tannery
stations.blurb: Fit flexible living material into protection and carrying work.
stations.buildBlurb: Corrin needs beams, fibre and salt enough to prepare a clean working room.

stations.name: The Bowyer
stations.blurb: Fit far-reaching physical weapons without an ammunition inventory.
stations.buildBlurb: Fen needs straight stock, patient fibres and enough resin to make every draw hold.

stations.name: The Armoury
stations.blurb: Rebuild one familiar protective piece around a deliberate defensive profile.
stations.buildBlurb: Bracken needs iron, clay and copper enough to rebuild protection without pretending its old shape was sacred.

stations.name: The Weaponsmith
stations.blurb: Fit advanced physical weapons to repeatable motion, reach and consequence.
stations.buildBlurb: Maud needs enough iron and copper to test the alteration, and a little gold for the measures that must not drift.

stations.name: The Scriptorium
stations.blurb: Learn to write smaller, and to say more with less.
stations.buildBlurb: Isolde needs a room with good light and a table that doesn't rock. She is very specific about the table.

stations.name: The Firepit
stations.blurb: Somewhere for the people you bring home.

stations.name: The Bestiary
stations.blurb: Everything you have met out there, and how the one you met compared.

stations.name: The Survey Post
stations.blurb: Instruments for reading a world you are standing in.
stations.buildBlurb: Mara wants somewhere flat, out of the wind, with a clear line to the horizon. She has been carrying the lenses this whole time.

stations.name: The Apothecary
stations.blurb: Remedies and preparations made from what the worlds grew.

stations.name: The Reliquary
stations.blurb: Edren's record of where people once stood, and what they left behind.
stations.buildBlurb: Edren needs shelves for fragments, broad tables for plans, and somewhere every recovered thing can keep its place.

stations.name: The Wayfarer's Table
stations.blurb: Routes, provisions and field notes arranged for whoever is leaving next.
stations.buildBlurb: Sela wants one table for maps and packing lists—not a counter, and not somewhere she is expected to stay.

stations.name: The Distillery
stations.blurb: Crystallise essence and attune it through world-made samples.
stations.buildBlurb: Auber needs vessels that make every fraction visible, and shelves where no residue is mistaken for nothing.

stations.name: The Channelworks
stations.blurb: Oda gives concentrated emanations a route and a boundary.
stations.buildBlurb: Oda needs a bench where a live core can be contained before it is given reach.

stations.name: The Anchorage
stations.blurb: Worlds rebound into the Atlas, kept where they can be reached again.
stations.buildBlurb: Tovin needs a quiet room for the Atlas and a frame stout enough to hold open a way that should have closed.
